reliability.rationale: The four-coefficient salinity hinge and temperature relation achieves0.0410217ppb versus0.0458915 flexible and0.0822193 salinity-only, improving both held casts. Three development and two confirmation casts limit certainty.

mechanism.rationale: A continuous water-mass mixing approximation is compatible with the profile. The33psu hinge is prespecified, not a discovered phase boundary. Calibrated fluorescence is not chemical DOC and may include temperature/sensor response.

novelty.rationale: Prior physical/statistical families are disclosed. This bounded literature check does not certify new laws or exhaustive novelty.

significance.rationale: Useful reproducible prediction or informative failure within a precisely scoped cohort; no automatic discovery score.

reproducibility.rationale: Inspected executable equation, coefficients, source/task definitions and saved group results; independent numerical execution belongs to the separate computational reviewer.

impact.rationale: No independent intervention, deployment-cost study or external experimental replication.

checks: Positive proposal separated from negative evidence
Primary-source context checked through public source pages; no new numerical assets acquired
limitations: One expedition/instrument, spatially dependent casts, no separate CDOM quality flag, and one planned cast fully excluded by prefit T/S flags. Thousands of depth rows do not establish broad replication.
Scientific-critical agent review is advisory; it is not human expert adjudication or independent experimental replication.
recommendations: Separate sensor-temperature response from water-mass chemistry with independently calibrated optical and chemical samples before biological/industrial interpretation.
